text:
Alex R: morning team, quick onboarding snag — I can sign into Console via SSO but the Admin > Feature Flags page shows a 403 and no toggle UI. need to flip a flag for a quick end-to-end smoke test.
Maya (identity): welcome Alex :wave: which env are you hitting? staging or prod?
Alex R: staging. screenshot says '403 Forbidden' when fetching /api/admin/flags.
Ravi (platform): @Alex R usually that means your SSO group mapping didn't include console-flag-editors or console-admins-staging. Lina, did people-ops attach groups for Alex?
Lina (people-ops): I processed the onboarding invite but I see the staging admin group wasn't included in the auto-mapping due to a missing attribute on the profile. I'll add it, should take a couple mins to propagate.
deploy-bot: created ticket ID=ID-10984 to add Alex R to console-flag-editors (staging). ETA 15m.
Alex R: I don't have any CLI keys configured yet to verify groups. is there a temporary workaround?
Ravi (platform): I can create a scoped session token for you with write access to the feature-flags API limited to a single flag. want 20m or 60m?
Alex R: 20m should be enough. only need to flip team/decoder/enable_fastpath.
Ravi (platform): generating token...
deploy-bot: ephemeral token issued: FF_OPS_XXXXX_REDACTED (expires in 20m). Add it via Console > Dev Tools > Use token, or set header 'X-Console-Token: FF_OPS_XXXXX_REDACTED'.
Alex R: used header, toggled the flag, smoke test passed. thanks! any advice so this doesn't happen to others?
Maya (identity): we'll add a verification step to the onboarding flow: check SAML attribute 'groups' includes console-flag-editors and console-admins-staging. quick check command for folks with CLI: `redwood-iam whoami --email alex.r@redwood.com --groups`
Lina (people-ops): added a checklist item to Onboarding Runbook under 'Access & Roles' and created a tiny contributor doc for managers to verify group assignment on day0.
Ravi (platform): also adding a note to platform-runbook: if you see `GET /api/admin/flags 403` then either token missing or user not in console-flag-editors; fallback: request ephemeral token via platform team in new-hires channel.
Alex R: perfect. one last question: where are flag changes recorded so I can reference them in the PR?
Ravi (platform): Admin > Audit Logs, filter resource=feature-flag, env=staging, actor=Alex R. API: `GET /api/admin/audit?resource=feature-flag&env=staging&actor=alex.r` (requires admin scope).
Alex R: awesome, closing out once the group add propagates. cheers all :white_check_mark:
